g.text: A mechanical screen does not validate tsunami timing
Ten stations · 80 frozen event settings and 80 pre-origin controls; failed settings retained.
DART uses publisher residuals (retrospective fit window unknown); coastal records are raw tidal levels.
No station has a validated physical onset or available modeled station arrival in this release.
Sources: NOAA/NCEI DART residuals, NOAA CO-OPS raw levels, IOC source-QC flags; NCTR account.
No projection; source datums retained. No interpolation, tide removal, new detector or physical arrival assignment.
